Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Safety-tier review. This change reads geometry for 4-axis wire toolpaths.

What looks good:

- Each plane uses a separate stitch operation. The consumed-run check rejects a ring with unused runs.
- A die face uses its one opening. A punch face with an opening remains refused.
- The decision file records the chosen rules and the alternatives.

Local validation:

The review used `.claude/worktrees/review-3222` on this machine. The PR trial-merged cleanly with upstream main `a35c9cb8197f484fca0f8311610bdc8594111a0f`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all seven steps. The build used the app unit tests and the five selected integration suites.

| Suite | Passed | Failed |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| app lib | 297 | 0 |
| setup_align_non_mill | 4 | 0 |
| wire_4axis | 8 | 0 |
| wire_fans | 6 | 0 |
| wire_stamp | 7 | 0 |
| wire_verify_tol | 2 | 0 |

`cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Extra suites run:

No extra suite was required by the fixture or importer rules. The diff changes neither fixtures nor importers.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

1. Restore the old `wire_ruled.rs`: five `wire_fans` tests failed. Restore the reviewed source: all six passed.
2. Allow the one-opening branch on any side: `punch_face_with_an_opening_is_refused_by_name` failed. Restore the reviewed source: all six passed.

The source matched the trial-merged tree after both mutations. No golden file changed, so no moved golden needed a line check.
